LanguageData.RitualFilter_Help_Tooltip:
Entered text will be matched against pawn names.
Examples of more advanced uses: • h:preg ➤ pregnant pawns • a>12 ➤ pawns older than 12 • t:tough ➤ pawns with tough trait • ab: ➤ pawns with abilities • mining<10 ➤ pawns with mining skill lower than 10 • !p:melee ➤ pawns without melee passion
